licence.content: OWASP project titles, categories, maturity labels, links and descriptions are OWASP Foundation content. owasp.org states: "Unless otherwise specified, all content on the site is Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike v4.0 and provided without warranty of service or accuracy." They are republished here under CC BY-SA 4.0, with attribution to the OWASP Foundation and owasp.org, and the same licence applies to the files under /data/owasp/.
licence.source_statement: owasp.org site footer, read on 22 November 2026
licence.changes_made: Selected fields only; descriptions reduced from HTML to plain text; media links left out (some are expiring signed links); graph derived from the published fields. Nothing else is changed: categories, maturity labels and descriptions are OWASP's own words.
licence.open: The project list endpoint (owasp.org/api/public/projects/list) is used by OWASP's own website and has no published stability or reuse statement of its own. The site-wide CC BY-SA 4.0 statement is taken to cover it; if OWASP says otherwise, these files come down and the site links instead.

snapshots.captured_by: A ChatGPT research conversation for Dinis Cruz (22 November 2026), with its collector scripts/capture.py (Python standard library).
snapshots.custody: Routed unchanged to this repository's branch inbox/chatgpt-owasp-handover-2026-11-22 (commit cecab44, folder handover/2026-11-22-chatgpt/research/OWASP.organization/data/), then copied byte for byte to /data/owasp/ by owasp.c@SovereignWebsite.dinis.
snapshots.validation_note: OWASP's counts endpoint gives 347 projects and maturity counts that sum to 331. The 16 not counted carry the project_type value "other" in the list; they are shown as "other", not given a level.
